name: trueline
description: Trueline — scan a building, correct it by hand, get a blueprint.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check-guide && npm run what-is-left && npm run check-tokens && npm run check-art && npm run check-swift && npm run check-the-checks && npm run site
scripts.ship-web: npm run build && rm -rf ios/Trueline/Web && mkdir -p ios/Trueline/Web && cp -R web/dist/. ios/Trueline/Web/
scripts.check-swift: python3 core/tools/check-swift.py && python3 core/tools/check-swift-names.py && python3 core/tools/check-pbxproj.py && python3 core/tools/check-doors.py
